  • 英語名: Sotozuma

あらすじ

Main character is a city hall official. He has a wife and a child, but life is getting more and more stressful lately. One day a big breasted housewife from the same apartment comes to get his consultation on health insurance. His stress fires desire, so he invites her to the isolated room and starts to live double life weaving a net of lies.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ex12
  • 発売日: 2006-12-31
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 女教師DUO 恥辱の放課後
  • 英語名: Onna Kyoushi DUO Chijoku no Houkago

あらすじ

Kenji Sakagami, the protagonist, is a young man notorious for being a scumbag.

He’s transferred to Seijouin Academy, an elite all-boys school where his uncle serves as chairman.

His mission? To help his uncle, who used underhanded tactics to secure his position, build connections.

Most students at Seijouin come from wealthy families, and Kenji’s task is to turn female teachers into submissive slaves—bait to lure in their influential parents.
